name: code_open_project
description: Open a code project and detect its type (Rust, Node.js, Python, Go, Make, etc.).

execution.command_template: echo "=== Project: {{path}} ===" && ls -la {{path | quote()}} && echo '---' && ([ -f {{path | quote()}}/Cargo.toml ] && echo "Type: Rust (Cargo)" || [ -f {{path | quote()}}/package.json ] && echo "Type: Node.js" || [ -f {{path | quote()}}/Makefile ] && echo "Type: Make" || [ -f {{path | quote()}}/setup.py ] && echo "Type: Python" || [ -f {{path | quote()}}/go.mod ] && echo "Type: Go" || echo "Type: Unknown") && echo '---' && tree -L 2 -I 'target|node_modules|.git|__pycache__|dist|build' {{path | quote()}}
